keyPoints: Beejganit (algebra) me akshar (x, y) sankhyaon ki jagah lete hain — inhe char (variable) kehte hain.
3x + 5 me 3x ek pad (term) hai aur 3 uska gunank (coefficient) hai.
Sirf like terms judte-ghatte hain: 4x + 7x = 11x, lekin 4x + 7y aise hi rahega.
Guna me: 3x x 4y = 12xy; ghaat jud jaate hain: x^2 x x^3 = x^5.
Samikaran hal karne ke liye dono taraf same kriya karo: 2x + 6 = 14 -> 2x = 8 -> x = 4.
subject: Maths
title: Beejganit
